sprint: THE ALPHA SPRINT — Phase 1 (AUDIT-FIRST). The comprehensive audit OF THE REAL TREE before one fix lands (X-AUDIT). Recorded verbatim as D22.
rule: no hardening lands before this audit; production code is written against AUDITED interfaces; where the tree contradicts the blueprint history THE TREE WINS and the discrepancy is recorded; an empty-findings subsystem carries the written 'audited-clean, here is what was checked'.

entryBattery.result: 953 pass / 2 skip / 7 fail across 144 files / 962 tests (after environment repair: bun install + the sidecar venv from requirements-studio.txt)
entryBattery.rootCause: all 7 read sprint/sprint-result/BUILDLOG-*.md continuity files that were NEVER committed to git (DISC-1)

assessment: NOT alpha-ready as-cloned. The engine core is sound (verdict path frozen and hash-pinned; provenance chain verifies; deps hono+zod only; no key-logging path found; no command-injection path found). What fails a stranger is the SHELL AROUND the engine: both served doors bind 0.0.0.0 while claiming localhost; :4444 has zero rate limiting on the two costly routes; the installer's venv auto-build is broken by a wrong path; setup is stale RWA-era and says nothing about the BYOK keys the alpha runs on; the flagship ask verb crashes on stock macOS bash 3.2; and a pristine clone's battery is red on 7 continuity tests referencing never-committed files. All are small, audited, closable.

blockers.finding: both servers export `default { port, fetch }` with no hostname — Bun.serve defaults to 0.0.0.0; the console banners say localhost but the bind is every interface
blockers.why: the unset-STUDIO_TOKEN 'safe because localhost' default is false on a LAN; /refresh + /ask are cost/quota endpoints reachable by any device on shared wifi
blockers.riskIfUnaddressed: quota drain, unwanted outbound capture, unauthenticated LAN writes to the studio ledger

blockers.finding: :4444 serve-reality applies NO per-caller rate limit on any route; GET /refresh triggers live network capture and GET /ask can call a paid AI API
blockers.why: serve-studio already carries limits (120/min + console 20/min); the mass-facing door carries none
blockers.riskIfUnaddressed: trivial cost-drain/DoS; operator IP throttled by DeFiLlama; paid key quota burned by a loop

blockers.finding: organon.sh setup() tests `[ -f "requirements-studio.txt" ]` at the REPO ROOT but the lockfile lives at src/backtest/py/requirements-studio.txt — the venv auto-build can NEVER run; every fresh clone reports the phantom 'python3 or the lockfile is absent'
blockers.why: the one install step the script claims to perform silently never happens; the sidecar battery then fails blaming the wrong cause
blockers.riskIfUnaddressed: every alpha stranger's first run is red with a misdiagnosis

blockers.finding: organon.sh never runs or suggests `bun install`; on a fresh clone the verify rows fail 'exit 1' (module-resolution errors swallowed) with no remedy line
blockers.why: contradicts 'when it refuses it says exactly why' — the most common fresh-clone failure has no stated cure
blockers.riskIfUnaddressed: strangers file 'it is broken' for a missing bun install

blockers.finding: organon-setup.sh is stale RWA-era: checks FRED_API_KEY + 'snapshot v4' (a parked pipeline whose data dir is gitignored-absent), its three printed next-steps are a dead script (organon-run.sh → nonexistent scripts/snapshot.ts + script/rwa-verdict.ts), a subset battery misnamed 'full', and a nonexistent monorepo path — and it says NOTHING about the BYOK AI keys the alpha actually runs on (no cp .env.example .env anywhere)
blockers.why: setup is the first script a stranger runs; every pointer leads wrong and the alpha's core flow (paste keys) is absent
blockers.riskIfUnaddressed: onboarding dead-ends at minute one; strangers chase a FRED key they do not need
blockers.roadmapSlot: phase-4 (the wizard rebuild IS the fix; interim honesty landed in phase-2)

blockers.finding: `./organon.sh ask` with no query crashes with 'ASK_ARGS[@]: unbound variable' on stock macOS bash 3.2 (set -u + empty-array expansion; verified on /bin/bash 3.2.57)
blockers.why: a raw shell error where the product's law demands a sentence — on the flagship verb, on the default Mac shell
blockers.riskIfUnaddressed: first contact with ask is a bash stack line

blockers.finding: 7 continuity tests (SF1 · V1 · V2 · V3 · SV1 · SV4 · P2) read sprint/sprint-result/BUILDLOG-*.md files that exist only on the original author's machine — never committed, no git history; a pristine clone's canonical battery is permanently red
blockers.why: `verify` GREEN on a pristine fresh clone is this sprint's own definition of done; the tree already carries the honest-absence precedent (honesty_record's 'gitignored (fresh clone)' pattern)
blockers.riskIfUnaddressed: every alpha tester's battery is red on arrival; the 960/2/0 claim is unreproducible

harden.finding: STUDIO_TOKEN Bearer check is a non-constant-time `!==` comparison (the token is otherwise never logged or rendered — correct)
harden.riskIfUnaddressed: theoretical timing oracle; cheap to fix

harden.finding: the Ask error path's key-safety margin is incidental: phrase.ts slices provider error text to 60 chars; the Gemini key rides the URL at ~char 94 — safe today by arithmetic, not by design (no scrubber exists)
harden.riskIfUnaddressed: a widened slice or an earlier-in-URL key leaks key material to the browser

subsystemsAuditedClean.architecture: checked: layout matches the pinned ground truth (src/organon·ledger·backtest·dataplane·analytics·ask·strategy·attest·studio; test/walls+organon); namespace-per-module, small pure functions, strict TS; no cyclic-import smell found on the audited paths
subsystemsAuditedClean.backend: checked: the serve paths render server-side Hono HTML; engine reads are pure; the durable ledger is append-only hash-chained; uncaught errors on studio routes land in a JSON envelope, not a stack page
subsystemsAuditedClean.provider-abstraction: checked: src/ask/provider.ts is the single adapter seam (gemini/openai/anthropic/groq/openai-compatible); NO provider-name branching exists outside it (verified across phrase/answer/truncation/factbudget/eval/gates/router — only provider.id passthrough in error/result fields); fromEnv priority documented
subsystemsAuditedClean.model-routing: checked: fromEnv priority GROQ→GOOGLE_AI_STUDIO→GEMINI→OPENAI→ANTHROPIC→OPENAI-COMPATIBLE; keyless → null → deterministic mode (phrase.ts:90); the AI layer is presentation-optional by construction
subsystemsAuditedClean.prompt-pipeline: checked: phrase→gates→truncation; the gates read engine facts only; scaleCap 220+45/fact ceil 1200; truncation detect+mark honest; no JSON-mode assumed anywhere
subsystemsAuditedClean.caching: checked: 60s TTL + last-good(stale-REAL) fallback in both data providers; resetCache seams for tests; the Ask transport serializes via a single queue (2.1s spacing, 429/5xx backoff ≤5 retries)
subsystemsAuditedClean.concurrency: checked: one module-level transport queue for AI calls; studio rate-limit windows per x-forwarded-for; the sidecar bridge spawns argv-form (no shell); no shared-mutable-state hazard found on the audited serve paths
subsystemsAuditedClean.error-handling: checked: data providers NEVER throw (degrade to last-good or SAMPLE with the note); hyperliquid throws to its caller which records BLOCKED; ask catches provider errors → deterministic fallback
subsystemsAuditedClean.retries: checked: AskProvider.rateLimited — exponential backoff, retry-after honored, jitter, cap 30s; data plane deliberately does NOT retry (degrade-and-label is the contract)
subsystemsAuditedClean.validation: checked: zod schemas on the studio mutating routes; 64KiB body cap BEFORE parse; unknown pool keys → honest 404 sentences on :4444
subsystemsAuditedClean.logging: checked: no code path logs a key or a request body (grep across src/ script/ *.sh); server banners log presence booleans only; the one incidental margin is AH3
subsystemsAuditedClean.skill-isolation: checked: skill/ = SKILL.md docs only; .impeccable/ = committed config.json + gitignored dev ephemera; NO runtime import of either from src/ or script/ serve paths
subsystemsAuditedClean.dependency-management: checked: bun.lock resolves exactly hono@4.12.27 + zod@4.4.3, zero transitive third-party additions
subsystemsAuditedClean.performance: checked lightly (no stranger-visible red flags): canonical battery ~90s; shelf/check/ask render server-side from committed artifacts + 60s-cached fetches; capture cadence is operator-invoked, not a hot loop — no finding filed
subsystemsAuditedClean.maintainability: checked: conventions consistent (walls-as-tests, pinned goldens, deviations ledger); dead code found is CONFINED to the transplant-era wrappers (AH7) — convicted, dispositioned
subsystemsAuditedClean.security: the blockers/harden entries above are the findings; additionally checked clean: command-injection (argv-form spawns only), XSS on :4444 (full esc()), key transit (headers/URL-param to providers only, never bodies/logs/pages)
